objective: Reduce cold lowering cost by resolving only nominal names used by each typed EHIR module and decoding import bindings once.

compiler_construction.method: Production CLI and implementation compiled as a standalone unit by the same converged seed; embedded test attributes removed. Clang -O0 arguments replaced with -O3 in both builds.

cold_policy: Fresh project target and private compiled cache per compiler. Dependency source cache preseeded. OS page cache retained. Dev profile, 8 jobs, no resource caps. Built-in frontend phase timers enabled; no external profiler. No overlapping tests or compiler builds during measurements.

old_expectation.reason: The fixture expected an untyped call argument. Mandatory typed EHIR emits call Bucket::new[T](value: T). The baseline and candidate both failed the old assertion; the expectation now checks the typed argument.

validation.native_probes: Camera, function and cook CLI probes passed after cold and unchanged builds for both variants.

limitations: Full build numbers are one matched Linux x86_64 pair, not a statistical or CI performance guarantee. Focused results use three paired samples.
Compared with development head bd644e0, not published 0.1.11.
Timing CLIs are matched standalone production implementations; the separately converged extreme binaries were checked for correctness, not used for this timing pair.
The full-build candidate snapshot precedes formatting. Final production source differs only in formatting and optional trailing commas; final source was independently tested and self-hosted.
Module-level phase sums and package wall times cover different scopes and must not be added together.
